frame.name: enu
frame.description: GPS-aligned enu of local_gps_recording_002, via T_enu_from_hdmap

lidar_frames.calib: Ouster sensor/calibration frame of a scan (x forward, y left, z up). X_map = T_map_from_calib(scan) @ X_calib
lidar_frames.os_lidar: frame of the raw .pcd points. X_calib = T_calib_from_os_lidar @ X_os_lidar

poses: poses.csv: per scan T_map_from_calib (LiDAR odometry + loop closure, ~3 cm consistency)
z: z is the road surface height in the map frame
